LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: forgotten event
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: Something happened that nobody remembers.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: settlement grew
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {SETTLEMENT} of {FACTION} has grown into a {TIER}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: settlement declined
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {SETTLEMENT} of {FACTION} has dwindled to a {TIER}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: famine
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: Famine grips {SETTLEMENT} of {FACTION}. Its people go hungry, and food fetches high prices there.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: new leader
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {FACTION} has a new {TITLE}: {NEW}{HOUSE} succeeds {OLD}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: war band marches
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: A war band of {FACTION} marched out of {ORIGIN} against {COLONY}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: raid ended
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {COUNT} warriors of {FACTION} from {ORIGIN} attacked {COLONY}; {FALLEN} of them did not come back.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: war declared
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {A} declared war on {B} ({CAUSE}).

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: joined a war
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {ALLY} took up arms for its ally {FRIEND} against {ENEMY}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: peace
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {A} and {B} made peace.{TERMS}

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: alliance
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {A} and {B} sealed an alliance.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: war ended
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: The war between {A} and {B} is over: {REASON}

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: faction destroyed
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {FACTION} is no more: its last settlement fell to {BY}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: settlement razed
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {ATTACKER} razed {SETTLEMENT} of {DEFENDER} to the ground.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: settlement captured
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {ATTACKER} conquered {SETTLEMENT}, taking it from {DEFENDER}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: settlement plundered
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: A war band of {ATTACKER} from {ORIGIN} stormed {SETTLEMENT} of {DEFENDER} and carried off its goods.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: attack repelled
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {DEFENDER} drove off an attack by {ATTACKER} on {SETTLEMENT}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: settlement founded
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: Settlers of {FACTION} from {ORIGIN} founded {SETTLEMENT}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: ruins resettled
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: Settlers of {FACTION} from {ORIGIN} rebuilt the ruins as {SETTLEMENT}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: your story begins
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: After {YEARS} years of history, your story begins.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: warlord fell
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {NAME}, {ROLE}, fell at {PLACE}. {FACTION} will not forget.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: death of a notable
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {NAME}, {ROLE}, died at {PLACE}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: notable joined you
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {NAME}, {ROLE}, has joined you.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: notable captured
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {NAME}, {ROLE}, is now your prisoner.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: guests praise you
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: Travellers back home in {ORIGIN} speak warmly of their stay at {COLONY}. Your name is good among {FACTION}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: guests complain
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: Travellers back home in {ORIGIN} complain about how they were treated at {COLONY}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: war band intercepted
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {CARAVAN} met a war band of {FACTION} from {ORIGIN} on the road.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: aid delivered
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: The people of {SETTLEMENT} received the {GOOD} they begged for. They will remember who helped them.

HistoryEventDef.label: destroyed a town of our enemies
took a town of our enemies

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: plague
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: Plague sweeps through {SETTLEMENT} of {FACTION}; {COUNT} people die.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: blight
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: Blight ruins the harvest of {SETTLEMENT} ({FACTION}). Food will be dear there.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: great fair
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: A great fair in {SETTLEMENT} ({FACTION}) draws merchants from far and wide.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: rebellion
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {SETTLEMENT} rose up against {PARENT}. The rebels call themselves {REBELS}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: town liberated
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: The people of {SETTLEMENT} rose against {OCCUPIER} and returned to {FOUNDERS}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: colony destroyed a settlement
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {COLONY} destroyed {SETTLEMENT} of {FACTION}. {FACTION} will remember.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: colony took a town
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {COLONY} took {SETTLEMENT} from {FACTION} and left its people their homes. {SETTLEMENT} is a free town now, and {FACTION} will want it back.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: free town lost
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {SETTLEMENT}, the free town {COLONY} held, is no longer its own: {OWNER} rules it now.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: free town rose against the colony
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {SETTLEMENT}, the free town {COLONY} held, rose against it: {FACTION} is no friend of the colony now.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: free town released
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {COLONY} released {SETTLEMENT} of {FACTION}, which no longer has anything to do with the colony.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: ruler fell
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {NAME}, {TITLE} of {FACTION}, died when {CONQUEROR} took {SETTLEMENT}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: war request fulfilled
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: Your colony destroyed {TARGET} as {ASKER} asked. They sent {REWARD} silver and their thanks.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: new ruler
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {NAME}, the new {TITLE} of {FACTION}, is said to be {TRAITS}, and means to {GOAL}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: commission delivered
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {COLONY} delivered {COUNT} {THING} that {NAME} had ordered for {HOME}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: a new people arrives
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {FACTION}, a people of the {TECH} age from beyond the known lands, have settled at {SETTLEMENT}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: a faction learns
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {FACTION}, once a people of the {OLD} age, have learned the ways of the {TECH} age.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: prisoner ransomed
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {FACTION} paid {SILVER} silver to {COLONY} for {NAME} of {HOME}, who went home.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: prisoner died in captivity
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {NAME} of {HOME} died a prisoner of {COLONY}. {FACTION} will not forget it.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: prisoner released
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {COLONY} set {NAME} of {HOME} free.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: a ruler visits the colony
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {NAME}, {TITLE} of {FACTION}, visited {COLONY} in person.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: ruler's new goal
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {NAME}, {TITLE} of {FACTION}, now means to {GOAL}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: ruler's goal achieved
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {NAME}, {TITLE} of {FACTION}, set out to {GOAL} — and did.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: ruler's goal abandoned
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {NAME}, {TITLE} of {FACTION}, has given up trying to {GOAL}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: peace with the colony
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {FACTION} accepted the peace offered by {COLONY}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: envoy murdered
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {FACTION} murdered the envoy of {COLONY} and kept the {SILVER} silver gift.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: call to arms answered
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {FACTION} answered the call of {COLONY} and marched against {ENEMY}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: tribute paid to the colony
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {FACTION} paid {SILVER} silver in tribute to {COLONY}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: tribute refused
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {FACTION} refused the tribute demanded by {COLONY}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: colony hired a war band
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {COLONY} paid {HIRER} to send a war band from {SOURCE} against {TARGET} of {ENEMY}: {OUTCOME}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: blood feud sworn
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {NAME}, {REL} of {FALLEN}, has sworn to kill {SLAYER} and now leads the war bands of {HOME}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: blood feud avenged
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {NAME} has avenged {FALLEN}: {SLAYER} is dead, {HOW}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: blood feud ended
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {SLAYER} slew {NAME}, who had sworn to avenge {FALLEN}. The blood feud with {HOME} is over.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: blood feud broken
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {NAME}, sworn to avenge {FALLEN}, is in the hands of {COLONY}. The blood feud with {HOME} is over.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: blood price paid
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {COLONY} paid {SILVER} silver in blood price for {FALLEN}. {NAME} of {HOME} has renounced the oath to kill {SLAYER}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: new ruling house
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: House {HOUSE} seizes the rule of {FACTION}: {NAME} ends the line of House {OLD} after {GENERATIONS} rulers.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: a name made
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {NAME} of {HOME} is known far and wide now: {ROLE}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: a figure retired
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {NAME}, {ROLE}, has grown old and handed on the work to {HEIR}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: towns joined by road
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {A} and {B} are joined by a {ROAD}.

LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.label: colony joined by road
LivingWorld.ChronicleEventDef.text: {COLONY} is joined to {SETTLEMENT} by a road.
